title: CPI(M) district committee meet in Keralam’s Pathanamthitta reviews poll setback, organisational issues
description: Speculation is rife that the CPI(M) leadership may initiate further action against veteran leader A. Padmakumar, former president of the Travancore Devaswom Board and legislator, who has been arraigned as an accused in the Sabarimala gold theft case
